input.summary: Cap the Termination Payment at three months of fees and limit HDI's convenience termination to the end of the then-current term.
input.comment: [Playbook] We kept the mutual 90-day notice, but capped the Company's Termination Payment at three months of fees instead of a share of a year's Net Sales, and limited HDI's no-cause termination to the end of the then-current term. This reflects our fallback position on termination for convenience.

ops.oldText: an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two, provided that the Termination Payment shall not exceed three (3) months of fees.

ops.oldText: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other.
ops.newText: This Agreement shall be automatically renewed for an additional one year period on each anniversary of the Effective Date, unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other, provided that termination by HDI shall be effective only at the end of the then-current term.
